SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, price, stock_qty FROM products WHERE price > 150 AND price < 300;

SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, price, stock_qty
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity, last_restocked, created_at FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;
SELECT product_name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, email, department_id, manager_id, hire_date, created_at FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;
SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, city, country, created_at FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hamburg';
SELECT department_name FROM departments WHERE location = 'Berlin';

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.stock_qty
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.city, c.country, c.created_at FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.department_id, e.manager_id, e.hire_date, e.created_at
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales'
SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.handled_by = e.employee_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker'

SELECT p.product_name, i.quantity 
FROM inventory i 
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id 
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id 
WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Munich Regional Warehouse'

SELECT c.category_name AS product_line
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name 
FROM products p 
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id 
WHERE i.quantity < 30;
SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Munich'
SELECT oi.* FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.stock_qty
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio';

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.hire_date
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment';

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.handled_by, o.order_date, o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.country = 'Germany';

SELECT i.*
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Hamburg Fulfillment Center'
  AND i.quantity > 100;

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.price, p.stock_qty
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.unit_price > 500;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.stock_qty
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment';

SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    YEAR(order_date) AS order_year,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    YEAR(order_date)
ORDER BY 
    order_year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id)
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%' OR p.product_name LIKE '%Laptop%'

SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status != 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name;

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name;

SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name;

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS average_price
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.city, c.country, c.created_at
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3

SELECT c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock
FROM products p
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_stock DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_sold_unit_price
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, 
    c.category_name;

SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Smartphones'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > (
    SELECT AVG(customer_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS customer_total
        FROM customers c2
        JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
        GROUP BY c2.customer_id
    ) AS avg_table
);
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, price, stock_qty FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
SELECT product_id, product_name, price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) as price_rank FROM products;

SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price
FROM products p
JOIN (
    SELECT category_id, MAX(price) AS max_price
    FROM products
    GROUP BY category_id
) m ON p.category_id = m.category_id AND p.price = m.max_price;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.handled_by, o.order_date, o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_value
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) ov ON o.order_id = ov.order_id
WHERE ov.order_value > (
    SELECT AVG(total_value)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_value
        FROM order_items
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) avg_table
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.city, c.country, c.created_at
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE (LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%laptop%' OR LOWER(cat.category_name) LIKE '%laptop%')
  AND w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin' AND w.is_active = 1;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_item_spend
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN (
    SELECT c_inner.customer_id
    FROM customers c_inner
    JOIN orders o_inner ON c_inner.customer_id = o_inner.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi_inner ON o_inner.order_id = oi_inner.order_id
    GROUP BY c_inner.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(oi_inner.quantity * oi_inner.unit_price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_cust ON c.customer_id = top_cust.customer_id;
